scope: Creatures, ecology and governed creature-role/content-entity coverage only. SGC-04C vehicle/module/media-resource coverage remains outside this unit.

evidence.specific_scope: CEW is completed through CEW-16. CEW-01/07/08 govern creature source identity, canonical coverage and creature-type coverage while preserving source-only candidates, unknowns and no name-only promotion. CEW application implementation authority remains false, so this row asserts governed content coverage rather than live runtime implementation.

Completed CEW separates habitat suitability, World/Reality/geographic distribution, ecological role/encounter use, Earthlike wildlife, environment-driven gaps, multiversal/alien wildlife, extraordinary creatures and GM discovery. ENV habitat/composition authority remains distinct and missing creature facts remain unresolved rather than inferred.

CEW-09 independently governs intelligence/personhood/domestication/partnership classification. Animal, Beast, sapience/personhood and NPC presentation remain independent, and sapient/person-level creatures require autonomy and voluntary-consent handling rather than taming-by-assumption.

CEW-10 preserves Time-of-Troubles-descended native fauna separately from later imports, Warden-bred/engineered, feral, relocated, returned/reintroduced and Riftfall-displaced origins. Human-level/sapient native Havalaean animals retain animal ecological identity; sapience does not imply ownership, tamability, obedience or loss of autonomy.

Completed CCP-08..10 own breeding/reproduction/lineage/inheritance, habitats/herds/stables/kennels/facility operations, and creature ecology/social behavior/lifecycle/World integration. These mechanics remain distinct from CEW source/content classification.
